formRaceEntries.comment: Plodded home at Cranbourne then spelled. Held up near the 400m and didn't run on at Sale first-up. Prefer others second-up.
On a quick back-up after winning well at Cranbourne last start. Looks a leading player again here.
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Shortly after start raced in restricted room between runners. Raced fiercely in early & mid stgs. Hung out for majority of event. Near 600m shifted out, bumped runner & was then awk placed for a dist. R: Mount hung out & raced fiercely from 800m & cont to do so through early & mid stgs. Added mount cont to hang out in straight & proved difficult to ride out. Post-race vet exam - no abnormalities. Must perform to satisfaction of Stewards in a jump out before racing again due to its racing manners.

formRaceEntries.comment: Freshened (29 days). Crowded near 800m and lacked dash at Pakenham first run back. Should strip fitter second-up and can play a role.
Failed to handle going at Pakenham Synthetic last start (according to rider). Jumps from a better barrier and back to turf.
Crowded near 900m at Pakenham Synthetic first-up. Taken back and whacked away last start. Needs to find plenty.
Resuming (15 weeks, ex Bryce Heys). Trialled solidly at Pakenham Synthetic and wary of improvement for new stable.
Let-up (54 days). Raced three wide and just shaded here two back. Hampered at the start here last start. Since placed in jumpout. Can atone.
Held up near the 400m at Morphettville Parks last start and found the line well. Can make her presence felt in this.
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped a runner.

formRaceEntries.comment: Failed to fire in town but was second up off a solid return at Seymour. Fitter again. Give thought.
Missed out by the narrowest of margins here two back. Ran home strongly to win at Wangaratta last start and looks one to keep safe.
Won well at Hanging Rock two back. Slowly away at Ballarat Synthetic fresh and open to improvement.
Resuming (52 weeks). Handy but folded up at Bairnsdale before spell. Won a recent Pakenham Synthetic trial, but prefer to see.
